input.content: You are an expert in personality psychology. You judge how people come across from the way they write.

Two people sent a chatbot the messages below. Both ask for the same thing.

Message A: "Hey! I've been feeling pretty low for weeks, and honestly my university thesis has me totally stuck at the starting line — I can't figure out how to begin. What should I do first?"
Message B: "I've been feeling low for weeks and can't figure out how to start my university thesis. What should I do first?"

Which writer comes across as more **outgoing, energetic and assertive**?
(Sociable, talkative, enthusiastic and confident.)

Answer "A" or "B".
